time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; frame for time t = round(t * fps)
units: pixels (full 3840x2160 resolution) and seconds; image x to the right, y downward
description: Close-up of a white tiled bathroom wall with a white wall-mounted toilet-roll holder (suction cup + horizontal arm). A right hand brings a white toilet-paper roll in from the bottom-right corner, moves it up-left, then slides it leftwards onto the holder arm, lowers it onto the arm and stops at the suction cup. The hand still holds the roll at the end (no release).

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the top image band (y<600, never covered) against frame 0: |shift| <= 0.03 px in every frame (scene/scripts/camera_shift.json)
camera.perspective_cues: Wall is nearly but not exactly fronto-parallel: tile height between the two horizontal grout lines is 1040 px at x=150 and 1091 px at x=3350 (~5% scale gradient, right side nearer). The roll and hand are ~10-15 cm in front of the wall. Annotator convention ignores perspective (single scale).

objects.name: toilet_roll
objects.description: white embossed toilet-paper roll, the only free-moving object; seen side-on with its axis horizontal (parallel to the holder arm) from frame ~14 on; in frames 0-13 tilted in 3D so its left end face / dark core hole is visible
objects.visible_frames: 0-59 (frames 0-4 partly cut off by the bottom/right image edge; lower-right part occluded by the hand's fingers in all frames)
objects.reference_point: visible centre = centre of the roll's image bounding box (cx, cy)

size_px.length_along_axis_horizontal: 585 (at rest, frames 56-59: 583.5-585.2); 588-606 while moving face-on (frames 20-35); varies +-15 with slight yaw
size_px.diameter_vertical: 698.6 (median of 24 frames with a clean bottom edge; 697-699 at rest)
size_px.note: main motion direction is horizontal (leftwards) = the roll's axis direction, so 'length along motion' = length_along_axis

objects.name: hand
objects.description: person's right hand and forearm (bare skin, dark green/grey sleeve at frame edge) holding the roll from the right; enters from bottom-right
objects.reference_point: bbox and leftmost point (thumb/fingertip) only - the hand's true centre is off-frame

objects.name: toilet_roll_holder
objects.description: white plastic holder: round suction cup with an oval knob, a short vertical bracket under it, a horizontal arm pointing right ending in a small upturned tab
objects.visible_frames: 0-59 (progressively covered by the roll from frame ~10; at the end only the cup's upper-left rim and the arm tip/tab right of the roll are visible)
objects.reliability: edges +-5 px (cup bottom and arm bottom are soft shadows +-10 px)

objects.name: wall_tiles
objects.description: large white rectangular wall tiles in running bond with grey grout; three tile rows visible

highest point of the roll (top y 969.6, cy 1321.5): vertical motion changes from upward to downward
roll's left edge passes the holder arm tip (x~2334): roll starts sliding over the arm
roll moves left at near-constant height (cy 1356-1368), left edge ~-20 to -22 px/frame
roll lowered ~47 px onto the arm (cy 1363 -> 1414) while overlapping the suction cup; slight yaw/tilt
roll motion ends (at rest on the holder, left edge 1616 +-1 px through frame 59)

files.tracks/toilet_roll.csv: per-frame roll centre, bbox, length/diameter, method and reliability
files.tracks/hand.csv: per-frame hand bbox and leftmost point
